author: barnabasbusa
content:
not sure if this is the place to discuss this specific EIP design, but I'm a bit worried what happens if 600k 0x01 validators will suddenly all set this field and our validator state blows up by like 70MB. Epoch boundaries are already a struggle, adding so much extra data in the beacon state size might cause unforeseen issues, that we might have a hard time testing on a devnet. 

A few suggestions that would help us mitigate sudden huge increase of validator state size could be that we limit this function to 0x02 validators only. 
Or
we don't write to the beacon state until its being used. We keep the registration on the el side in the contract and once the pq fork is active it drains them to the cl side.
